from.description: Start of the analysis window in router local time (`YYYY-MM-DD` or `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`). Alias: `since`, `start_date`. When omitted, `days` (default 7) is used unless `all_time=true`.

to.description: End of the analysis window in router local time (`YYYY-MM-DD` or `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`). A date-only value (`YYYY-MM-DD`) includes the full day through `23:59:59`. Alias: `until`, `end_date`.

date.description: Single calendar day shortcut (`YYYY-MM-DD`), equivalent to setting both `from` and `to` to that day. Alias: `day`.

days.description: Number of calendar days ending today on the router's clock (1 = today only, 7 = today + previous 6 days). Default 7 when no date range is specified.

all_time.description: When true, analyze all retained accounting records without a start-date cutoff. Warning: on routers with tens of thousands of historical sessions this may take 15–20 seconds.

user.description: Filter to a specific OpenVPN username (exact match by default, or substring match when `user_match='contains'`; also accepts comma-separated usernames). Alias: `username`.

users.description: Filter to any of the listed OpenVPN usernames.

user_match.description: How to match `user` / `users`: `'exact'` (case-insensitive exact username match, default) or `'contains'` (case-insensitive substring match).

caller_id.description: Filter by client public source IP (`calling-station-id` / `caller-id`). Matches exact IP or prefix/substring. Alias: `source_ip`, `client_ip`.

address.description: Filter by assigned OpenVPN tunnel IP (`user-address` / `address`, e.g. `10.10.6.215`). Alias: `tunnel_ip`.

status.description: Filter by session state: `'all'` (both active and closed sessions, default), `'active'` (currently connected only), or `'closed'` (disconnected/completed only).

active_only.description: Shortcut for `status='active'` when true, or `status='closed'` when false.

terminate_cause.description: Filter by RADIUS disconnect / terminate cause (e.g. `'lost-carrier'`, `'idle-timeout'`, `'user-request'`, `'session-timeout'`, `'admin-reset'`). Case-insensitive substring or exact match.

exclude_zero_traffic.description: When true, exclude 0-byte connection attempts (handshake/reconnect retries where download + upload = 0) from the primary aggregations. Even when false, the report separately counts `nonZeroTrafficSessions` vs `zeroTrafficSessions`.

min_total_bytes.description: Only include sessions whose combined download + upload bytes are at least this value.

min_download_bytes.description: Only include sessions whose client download bytes are at least this value.

min_upload_bytes.description: Only include sessions whose client upload bytes are at least this value.

min_duration_seconds.description: Only include sessions whose duration (uptime in seconds) is at least this value.

max_duration_seconds.description: Only include sessions whose duration (uptime in seconds) is at most this value.

include_daily_breakdown.description: Include per-user-per-day and all-users-per-day connection counts, durations, and download/upload/total byte breakdowns.

include_sessions.description: Include the paginated list of individual OpenVPN sessions with per-session download, upload, total bytes, duration, caller IP, tunnel IP, and timestamps.

include_inactive_users.description: When true (and no user filter is active), include configured OpenVPN/User Manager accounts that had 0 matching connections in the window.

sort_users_by.description: How to sort the per-user summary table.

sort_sessions_by.description: How to sort the individual sessions list.

session_limit.description: Maximum number of individual session records to return in `sessions` (1–1000, default 100). Aggregations always cover 100% of matching sessions regardless of this limit.

session_offset.description: Pagination offset into the sorted `sessions` list.
